answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.793, matching system-prompted (0.79-0.82) and ruling out quantized (10-17) and fine-tuned (5.5-8). The logit change is at or beyond the top of the system-prompted range (KL 0.473, top-1 agreement 0.820). Activations show onset at layer 8, a plateau of about 0.49 at layer 16 and 0.516 at layer 32, a layer-2 spike of 31.2, a size ratio of 0.971, and low cosine (0.844) with effective rank 2.83. All of these fit system-prompted; the spike is far above the fine-tuned maximum of 6.1. Values run slightly more extreme than the documented ranges, but the pattern is clear.
